{"id":2064644879,"question_id":4351,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week, 4 days","timestamp":1783836227,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2064644879/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Total Cost to Process All Elements","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int mod = 1e9+7;\n\n    ll calculateCost(ll oprs, ll count)\n    {\n        ll temp = (count % mod) * ((2 * oprs + count + 1) % mod);\n        temp /= 2;\n        return temp % mod;\n    }\n    \n    int minimumCost(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        ll ans = 0;\n        ll operations = 0;\n        ll resource = k;\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            if(resource < nums[i])\n            {\n                ll need = nums[i] - resource;\n                ll countofoprs = ceil((double)need / k);\n                ans = (ans + calculateCost(operations , countofoprs)) % mod;\n\n                operations += countofoprs;\n                resource += ((countofoprs * k) % mod);\n            }\n            resource -= nums[i];\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-total-cost-to-process-all-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2326}
